scope: full batch external comparison, NOT per-edition conclusive verification
limitations: The April Champions dataset has 258 entries; newer source lists >300, so roster absence is not proof of absence.
Showdown master is cross-source comparison, not a verified Gen IX snapshot.
Pokemon/forms with ambiguous mappings excluded, not counted as mismatches.
A source repository verified flag is not independent game verification.
Evolution, experience, gender, cosmetic, and growth fields need versioned independent references.
